about_the_game:
"Reclaim the Souls, Protect the Dimensions!"

Story
Akane, Koro, and Shiro finally achieved peace after their deadly battle with Dark Ego in the first game. However, that peace did not last long.
The demon Belial, revealing his hidden identity, devises a sinister plan called "Species Unification" and steals souls from countless dimensions, turning them into lifeless husks.
In this adventure, a new companion joins the party: Lea, a mysterious onmyoji girl. The cat girls embark on a journey to reach the "End of Dimensions" where Belial awaits, in order to stop his evil plan.
Throughout their journey across dimensions, can Akane and her friends reclaim the lost souls and restore balance to the world?

Key Features

Adventure Beyond Dimensions

  • Explore world-famous landmarks corrupted by darkness

  • Various backgrounds including the Eiffel Tower, downtown Tokyo, and more

  • Unique enemies and bosses appear in each dimension

Cute and Brave Magic Cat Girls

  • Archmage Koro: Freeze enemies with ice magic and shatter them with her magic staff

  • Akane: A power-type warrior who crushes frozen enemies with devastating strikes

  • Lea: An onmyoji who attacks with a giant brush and deals additional damage with splattered paint

  • Each character has unique combat styles and magic skills

Innovative Combat System - When Magic Staffs Become Blunt Weapons!

  • Unique concept of physically beating enemies with magic staffs

  • Perfect harmony of intense melee combos and spectacular magic effects

  • Parry System: Deflect enemy attacks with perfect timing and stun them

  • Aerial Combos: Launch enemies into the air for continuous strikes! Each hit produces a "Ding!" and drops a coin

  • Addictive coin acquisition system just like Mario's coin blocks

Perfect Blend of Beat 'em Up × Soul-like

  • Regular Combat: Classic beat 'em up style with satisfying impact

  • Boss Battles: Tense soul-like elements

  • Unique bosses including the Dark Knight of a French castle and the Corrupted Druid of downtown Tokyo

  • Strategic boss battles through the Parry-Stun-Combo cycle

2-Player Co-op

  • Protect dimensions together with a friend!

  • Combo plays utilizing character synergies

  • Fantastic cooperative combat where Koro freezes, Akane shatters, and Lea's paint deals additional damage

Character Growth System

  • Strengthen your characters with coins acquired from aerial combos

  • Unlock new magic skills

  • Upgrade various stats including attack power, parry timing, combo damage, and more

  • Experience the joy of growing stronger against increasingly powerful enemies

Charming Pixel Art

  • Enhanced graphics and impact feedback compared to the predecessor

  • Adorable pixel art style

  • Spectacular magic effects and satisfying attack animations

Game Modes

  • Story Campaign: A journey across dimensions to stop Belial's plan

  • Co-op Mode: 2-player cooperative play with friends

  • Boss Rush: Consecutive boss battle challenge mode

  • Tutorial: Step-by-step learning of parry and combo systems

The grand adventure of the cat girls' friendship, survival, and protecting the world begins now.
Join the journey to protect the dimensions!
It's time to reclaim souls, revive lost vitality, and face the true end of the adventure.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.00 GHz
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650
  • DirectX: Version 10

Recommended:

  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 10

short_description: Demon invasion has shattered the dimensions, filling the world with corrupted souls. Cat girls with unique stories unite through friendship to restore balance by purifying souls and facing fierce bosses. An exciting and adorable side-scrolling action adventure!
